integrity: Analytical proof and reproducible numerical checks; independent assessment not performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite particle population and instantaneous whole-population resets; no growing-N or finite-time convergence-rate theorem. Universal independence for gamma<=1; positive-covariance formula only for exact power-speed CDF. No stationary extended renewal-age law at infinite mean.
title: A sharp loss of collective correlations at the infinite-mean ballistic resetting boundary
